title: Pezeshkian Tells UN Iranians Are 'Victims of Terrorism,' Cites Minab School Strike
detail: In a defiant UN General Assembly address a day after Trump threatened to 'annihilate' Iran, President Masoud Pezeshkian rejected the 'number one sponsor of terror' label and said Iranians are instead 'victims of terrorism,' accusing the US and Israel of stoking global instability through illegal attacks on Iranian civilians and infrastructure. He cited the strike on an elementary school in Minab, saying it killed more than 150 people including over 120 children, and said Iran would fight 'until our last breath' while remaining open to genuine negotiation.

media.caption: Iran's President Pezeshkian tells the UN Iranians are 'victims of terrorism'

title: Araghchi Hands US Envoys Written 60-Day Ceasefire Roadmap at UN
detail: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi handed US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner a written roadmap proposing a regionwide ceasefire of up to 60 days, a phased reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, and an end to the US naval blockade, during a roughly three-hour session in New York mediated by Qatar, Pakistan and Egypt. The document also calls for a halt to Iranian attacks on Arab neighbors and an agreed timeline for substantive talks while the ceasefire holds. It sets up a sequencing dispute with Washington, which wants Iranian goodwill steps before any blockade relief.

media.caption: Iran presents the US with a roadmap for a regionwide ceasefire and Hormuz reopening

title: Pentagon Identifies 19th US Service Member to Die in Support of Iran War
detail: The Army identified Maj. Bianca C. Wilkerson, 37, of Norfolk, Virginia — posthumously promoted from captain — as the 19th US service member to die while deployed in support of the war with Iran. Wilkerson, assigned to Headquarters, US Army Central & Third Army at Shaw Air Force Base, died September 18 in a non-combat, medical-incident death while deployed to Doha, Qatar supporting overseas operations; her death was recorded in the Pentagon's system on September 21 and publicly announced September 23. The Washington Post had separately reported Sept 18-19 that undisclosed deaths put the true US toll at 22 or more, a figure the Pentagon has not confirmed.

media.caption: Army identifies Maj. Bianca C. Wilkerson as the 19th US service member to die amid the Iran war
